key.name: show-drun-button
key.description: Whether to show the button that opens `gdmenu --drun --fullscreen`.

key.name: show-window-button
key.description: Whether to show the button that opens `gdmenu --window --fullscreen`.

key.name: show-workspace-names
key.summary: Show workspace name label and drag-over hint
key.description: Whether to show the workspace name in the panel and as a hint while dragging a window over a thumbnail.

key.name: toolbar-icon-size
key.summary: Icon size for panel toolbar buttons
key.description: Size of the 'apps' and 'all windows' button icons in the panel (pixels).

key.name: icon-size
key.summary: Default icon size for window previews
key.description: Size of each window icon in the workspace thumbnails (pixels).

key.name: thumbnail-min-width
key.summary: Minimum width of each workspace thumbnail
key.description: Minimum width of each workspace thumbnail in the panel (pixels).

key.name: workspace-name-font-size
key.summary: Font size of the workspace name label
key.description: Font size of the workspace name displayed in the panel (pixels).

key.name: hover-preview-height
key.summary: Height of the hover preview window clone
key.description: Height of the live preview shown when hovering over a window icon (pixels).

key.name: title-popup-font-size
key.summary: Font size of the title popup (Ctrl‑held)
key.description: Font size of the title popup shown while holding Ctrl (points).

key.name: collection-search-font-size
key.summary: Font size of the collection overlay search entry
key.description: Font size of the search entry in the window collection overlay (points).

key.name: collection-result-font-size
key.summary: Font size of the collection overlay result items
key.description: Font size of the search result items in the collection overlay (points).

key.name: collection-result-icon-size
key.summary: Icon size for search result items
key.description: Size of application icons shown in the search results overlay (pixels).

key.name: clone-title-font-size
key.summary: Font size of the window title overlay on preview clones
key.description: Font size of the window title shown on hover previews and collection overlay previews (pixels).

key.name: close-button-size
key.summary: Size of the close button on previews
key.description: Size of the close button icon on previews (pixels).
